chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, from ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: Whoever performs the Friday prayer without reciting Sūrat al-Jumuʿah and al-Munāfiqīn must repeat the salat (prayer), whether in travel or residence.

The proper understanding of this report is encouragement that one should treat what he prayed without al-Jumuʿah and al-Munāfiqīn as being among the supererogatory prayers, and begin the salat (prayer) anew so that he may attain the merit of these two surahs; this clarifies what we have mentioned.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday prayer, and here also the surah associated with it
key_terms.الْمُنَافِقِينَ: Sūrat al-Munāfiqīn, the paired surah recommended for Friday prayer
key_terms.حَضَرٍ: a state of residence, not traveling

ai.seo_question: Must one repeat Friday prayer if Sūrat al-Jumuʿah and Sūrat al-Munāfiqīn were not recited?
ai.summary: This hadith concerns the recitation for Friday prayer and stresses the special merit of Sūrat al-Jumuʿah and Sūrat al-Munāfiqīn. The concluding clarification explains that the report is understood as strong encouragement to repeat the prayer in order to gain the virtue of reciting these two surahs.
